sloka: हयेषु व्यग्रहस्तं तं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।धनुष्यथ पुनर्व्यग्रे हयेषु मुमुचे शरान् ।। ६.९०.४५ ।।
transliteration: hayeṣu vyagrahastaṁ taṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।dhanuṣyatha punarvyagre hayeṣu mumuce śarān ।। 6.90.45 ।।

translations.english: While Indrajith was moving undaunted being hurt, Lakshmana who acts with extreme alacrity and fearless easily pierced Indrajith with arrows.
